title: George Ball's Vietnam memos with dismissive Dean Rusk cover notes in the Nixon transition papers

tellings.quote: and there was a bunch of papers with letter from George B to the president pleading with let's downsize this whole Vietnam thing before it blows up in your face

plain: Harold Malmgren, who says he advised several US presidents, recalls going through the papers handed over when Richard Nixon took office in 1968 and 1969. He says he found letters from George Ball, a senior State Department official, pleading with the president to scale back the Vietnam War before it blew up, with dismissive cover notes from Dean Rusk, the secretary of state. He tells it to show the kind of secret, high-level papers he says he handled directly.
